rationale:
Evidence. Iteration 4 (kp 1.7, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.2, same sensing) is the best raced design at 443.3. Against iteration 3 (kp 2.0), the oval rose to 16/20 finishes with progress 0.96, and the s-bend went from 0 to 4 finishes with progress 0.72 and line-loss events down from 1.1 to 0.95. Slalom did not change: still 0 finishes, progress 0.23, and exactly 1.0 line-loss event per run. Across iterations, lowering kp from 2.5 to 2.0 to 1.7 has helped each step on the oval and s-bend, while kp 2.5 made slalom line loss worse. Kd 0.3 to 0.5 cut oval line loss from 1.1 to 0.55 with oscillation still under 0.4.

The Evaluator's entityR1 note asks for a base_speed 1.4 test. I am not taking that step. Its condition (line loss near 1.0 or below on s-bend and slalom) is not met, and the speed limit has only been reached on the oval, so faster driving would add risk on the tracks that still lose the line. The entityR1 candidate is also identical to iteration 4's raced design, so racing it again would add no information.

Change. From the best raced design (iteration 4), change one value: controller.kp 1.7 to 1.5. Everything else stays the same (kd 0.5, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction, same sensor geometry and sensor_weights). The aim is to continue the kp trend that has helped the oval and s-bend, and to see whether the slalom line loss responds to weaker correction.

Expected result. S-bend finishes and progress should rise further, and slalom line_loss_events should fall below 1.0. Oval finishes should hold at about 14 or more of 20, with progress at or above 0.9.

Risks and hypotheses. (H1) kp 1.5 under-corrects tight oval bends, so oval finishes fall. (H2) The slalom line loss is driven by over-correction at kp 1.7, which would show as falling slalom line loss and progress. If slalom line loss stays at 1.0 with kp 1.5, the cause is not gain, and the next test should be kd (0.6) or line_loss (search_left or search_right) rather than more kp reduction. Steering oscillation on the s-bend was already 0.40 at kd 0.5, so if it goes above 0.4 the next step is kd 0.6 with the oscillation guard.

Measurements requested: per-track completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation, and control_effort, so the change in slalom line loss can be separated from the change in oval finishes.
